source_note: H1 2026 column rebuilt 2026-10-06 from the issuer H1 2026 interim report (Unilever Nigeria Plc H1 Interim Financial Report, statement of profit or loss, year to date 30 June 2026, NGX filing library doclib 47500): Revenue 119,923,255,000; Cost of Sales 65,184,675,000; Gross Profit 54,738,580,000; Operating Expenses 31,160,381,000 (selling and distribution 4,771,072 plus marketing and administrative 26,389,309); Operating Profit (EBIT) 24,359,220,000; Net Finance Costs -4,816,567,000 (net finance income); Profit Before Tax 29,175,787,000; Income Tax 13,577,949,000; Net Profit 15,597,838,000; EPS 2.72. UNIT: NGN. Prior H1 2026 cell set was wrong: Cost of Sales had been back-filled as Revenue minus Net Profit and Gross Profit, Operating Profit and Profit Before Tax had all been set to the Net Profit figure. Identities checked: Revenue minus Cost of Sales = Gross Profit; Profit Before Tax minus Income Tax = Net Profit.
marketCapSource: NGX 'List of Equities as of 2026-04-09' (doclib.ngxgroup.com), shares outstanding
reconciliation_note: Gross Profit - Operating Expenses = Operating Profit (EBIT) does not hold in FY2022; the operating expenses for those periods are withheld (see the row note). Gross Profit - Operating Expenses = Operating Profit (EBIT) does not hold in FY2025, FY2024: the filed operating profit is a subtotal that also carries operating income not shown as a separate row in this file, and it ties forward to Profit Before Tax. The figure is corroborated by the statement's own bridge and is shown unchanged.
periodOrder: repaired 2026-10-04: periods were not newest-first; reordered so periods[0] is the newest period and every value stays on its own period label
